entities.title: Iron Haze
entities.summary: A dieselpunk real-time strategy game made in Godot 4: oil wells, ironclads, howitzers, zeppelins and a build-order AI. It runs in the browser (Compatibility renderer) and as desktop builds (Forward+), for players holding the invite-only role games:iron-haze.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/ (every model, effect and the terrain made in code, no art assets), the landing page and the play page's static files in web/, the Cloudflare Worker that gates every file on games:iron-haze in worker/, its tests in test/, and screenshots in docs/. One npm project, built by build.mjs (web export, three desktop exports, the landing page) and deployed as one Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/ and the login service, neither edited here.
The role games:iron-haze is declared in icelander.net's accounts/src/config.js and granted at icelander.net/private/admin; the games list there hides the game from anyone without it.
No database, no API and no high-score table: the game runs entirely in the player's browser or on their computer.
